class.name: TextInsertionServer
class.brief_description: Fills [code]{name}[/code] placeholders in texts from call arguments, providers, values and [TextInsertionValues] resources.

method.name: add_values
method.description: Adds a [TextInsertionValues] resource as a source of values, ordered by its [member TextInsertionValues.priority]. Changes to the resource, including its priority, take effect immediately and emit [signal values_changed].

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value set with [method set_value] for [param name], or [param default] if there is none. Providers and resources are not considered.

method.name: has_modifier
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a custom modifier is registered under [param name]. Built-in modifiers are not included.

method.name: has_provider
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a provider is registered for [param name].

method.name: has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a value is set with [method set_value] for [param name]. Providers and resources are not considered.

method.name: insert
method.description: Returns [param text] with its placeholders replaced. [param args] has the values with the highest priority. [param escape] decides if the inserted values are escaped for [RichTextLabel], see [enum Escape]. A text without braces is returned unchanged without parsing. Other texts are parsed once and kept in a cache of 256 parsed texts.

method.name: insert_template
method.description: Like [method insert], for a text parsed with [method parse]. This is the fastest way to insert the same text many times.

method.name: notify_changed
method.description: Emits [signal value_changed] for [param name]. Call it when the value a provider returns has changed, so that texts using [param name] are inserted again.

method.name: parse
method.description: Parses [param text] into a [TextInsertionTemplate]. The template can be inserted many times with [method insert_template] and tells which names it uses.

method.name: register_modifier
method.description: Registers a custom modifier, used as [code]{value:name}[/code]. [param modifier] receives the value and returns the new value: [code]func(value: Variant) -> Variant[/code]. The built-in modifiers [code]t[/code], [code]upper[/code], [code]lower[/code], [code]capitalize[/code], [code]number[/code] and [code]f[/code] cannot be replaced. Emits [signal values_changed]. An unknown modifier leaves the value unchanged and prints a warning once in debug builds.

method.name: register_provider
method.description: Registers a provider for [param name]: a [Callable] without arguments that returns the value, called on every insertion that uses [param name]. A provider replaces an earlier one for the same name. Emits [signal values_changed]. Providers are only called on the main thread. Call [method notify_changed] when the returned value changes.

method.name: remove_value
method.description: Removes the value set with [method set_value] for [param name] and emits [signal value_changed].

method.name: remove_values
method.description: Removes a [TextInsertionValues] resource added with [method add_values] and emits [signal values_changed].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets a value for [param name] and emits [signal value_changed]. It is used when no argument or provider has [param name] and takes priority over all [TextInsertionValues] resources.

method.name: unregister_modifier
method.description: Removes the custom modifier [param name] and emits [signal values_changed].

method.name: unregister_provider
method.description: Removes the provider for [param name] and emits [signal values_changed].

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the value for [param name] is set or removed with [method set_value] or [method remove_value], and by [method notify_changed]. A text bound to a [TextInsertionTemplate] only needs to be inserted again if [method TextInsertionTemplate.has_name] returns [code]true[/code] for [param name]. Always emitted on the main thread.

signal.name: values_changed
signal.description: Emitted when any number of values may have changed: a [TextInsertionValues] resource is added, removed or changed, or a provider or modifier is registered or removed. Always emitted on the main thread.

constants.constant: Inserts the values as they are.

Escapes the opening brackets of the inserted values for [RichTextLabel], so that BBCode tags in values (for example in a player name) are shown as text. The text around the placeholders is not escaped.
